description:
## 2.3.0-dev.0

- refactor: separate the two biggest patches from their emitters
- refactor: give every feature's fingerprints one place to live
- refactor: name ToolbarIdAdmissionPatch.kt for what it declares
- docs: stop three patch descriptions describing a build nobody gets
- fix: restore the seventh feature to the Hidden Features description
- feat: let a hoisted flag default be overridden per call site
- refactor: fold Grammar Check Row into Hidden Features
- feat: Hidden Features — five flags a resigned build can never receive
